Poland Joins European Coalition to Boost Ukraine's Air Defence

Poland announced that it is joining an anti‑ballistic missile coalition led by Ukraine and involving other European partners. The coalition’s purpose is to develop an alternative, lower‑cost missile‑defence system for Ukraine. Prime Minister Donald Tusk also disclosed a new, sizable donation package for Ukraine. Tusk added that Poland will not cede any territory, reiterating this after recent Russian drone activity. The statements were made in recent statements by the Polish government.
